scheme_name: iCreate – International Centre for Entrepreneurship and Technology
overview: iCreate – International Centre for Entrepreneurship and Technology is a state-level (Gujarat) technology business incubator supported by the Government of Gujarat and the Government of India. It operates as a public-private partnership to foster next-generation entrepreneurship by supporting tech-based startups through incubation, mentorship, funding, and market access. iCreate provides end-to-end support from idea to scale-up, including prototype development, seed funding, and accelerator programs, with a focus on sectors like EV, agritech, healthtech, and renewable energy.
objectives: Facilitate 'Next Generation Entrepreneurship' by supporting tech-based startups
Empower Indian youth to pursue entrepreneurial dreams instead of seeking jobs
Provide incubation, mentorship, and funding support at every stage of the entrepreneurial journey
Leverage world-class innovation to address national priorities through centres of excellence
Build a vibrant entrepreneurial ecosystem involving corporates, government, investors, and institutional partners
Support prototype development and market readiness through rapid prototyping labs and validation
Enable global collaboration via international accelerator programs like India Israel Innovation Accelerator (i3A)
Disburse government grants and funding schemes available from central and state governments
eligibility: Eligibility varies by program: For Spark-up Idea Fund, any student or team from any discipline and college can apply if the idea is implementable, commercially viable, and new or a better alternative. For NIDHI-SSS, applicants must be slightly mature startups (1-3 years old) with advanced prototyping, revenue generation, bootstrapped funding, and incorporated as a Private Limited Company or capable of incorporation within 45 days. For iCreate Pro-Fund Gateway, applicants must be individual innovators, students, or startups, Indian citizens, in Idea-to-PoC or PoC stage, with hardware/software tech innovation; for Government of Gujarat grants, startups must be registered as LLP or private limited company in Gujarat. For iCreate Idea Catalyst (iIC), applicants include entrepreneurs, teams, university/college students, inventors, researchers, and individuals passionate about solving problems with innovative ideas.
benefits: Benefits include access to funding (grants up to Rs 50,000 for students, up to Rs 30 lakhs from Government of Gujarat, up to Rs 10 lakhs from NIDHI-PRAYAS, up to Rs 7 lakhs from TIDE 2.0, up to Rs 2 lakhs from TEC grant), mentorship from domain experts, access to iLab@iCreate rapid prototyping facilities, hostel and office space, market and investor connects, participation in accelerator programs, alumni network, business and technical mentorship, capacity building workshops, library access, cafeteria and hostel accommodation, and support for commercialization and expansion.
financial_support: Financial support varies by program: Spark-up Idea Fund offers up to INR 50,000 for students; NIDHI-PRAYAS provides up to Rs 10 lakhs for prototype development over 18 months (extendable by 6 months); TIDE 2.0 offers Rs 7 lakhs per startup for nascent startups with PoC to develop MVP; Government of Gujarat Startup Gujarat offers grants up to Rs 30 lakhs for product development and go-to-market over 12 months; TEC grant provides up to Rs 2 lakhs for PoC development in 90 days; NIDHI-EIR offers a monthly stipend of Rs 10,000–30,000 for up to 12 months; NIDHI-SSS provides seed support between Rs 25 lakhs to Rs 45 lakhs (up to Rs 100 lakhs in exceptional cases) as interest-bearing debt or equity; iCreate Pro-Fund Gateway facilitates access to multiple government grants including NIDHI-PRAYAS, TIDE 2.0, Startup Gujarat, NIDHI-EIR, and TEC grants.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to Rs 30 lakhs (Government of Gujarat), Up to Rs 10 lakhs (NIDHI-PRAYAS), Up to Rs 7 lakhs (TIDE 2.0), Up to Rs 2 lakhs (TEC grant), Up to Rs 50,000 (Spark-up Idea Fund)
application_process: 1. Identify the relevant program (e.g., Spark-up Idea Fund, NIDHI-SSS, iCreate Pro-Fund Gateway, iCreate Idea Catalyst). 2. Check eligibility criteria for the specific program. 3. Apply during the application window (dates vary by program; e.g., Spark-up Idea Fund: open 1 Jul, close 31 Jul). 4. Submit required documents via the application portal or email. 5. Await shortlisting notification (e.g., 10 Aug for Spark-up Idea Fund). 6. Attend final pitch or evaluation session (e.g., 16 Aug for Spark-up Idea Fund). 7. Receive final result and begin onboarding (e.g., 20 Aug for Spark-up Idea Fund). 8. Sign NDA and start working from iCreate Campus (e.g., 26 Aug for Spark-up Idea Fund).
required_documents: Proof of student status (for Spark-up Idea Fund)
Proof of concept or prototype details
Incorporation documents (for Gujarat-based startups under Government of Gujarat grants)
deadlines: Rolling basis for some programs; specific windows for others (e.g., Spark-up Idea Fund: Application Open 1 Jul, Close 31 Jul, Announcing Shortlisted Startups 10 Aug, Final Pitch 16 Aug, Announcing Final Result 20 Aug, Onboarding 26 Aug)
implementing_agency: International Centre for Entrepreneurship and Technology (iCreate), supported by the Government of Gujarat and the Government of India
contact_details: Email: info@icreate.org.in | Phone: +91 90998 43432 | Address: Opp. Kensville Golf Club and Resort, Off. Bavla - Rajkot Highway, Deo Dholera, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382240
caveats: Funds are disbursed in tranches subject to progress review (e.g., NIDHI-PRAYAS, TEC grant)
Equity may be taken by iCreate in certain programs (e.g., NIDHI-SSS: 7.5% equity at par)
Some grants are interest-bearing debt to be repaid (e.g., NIDHI-SSS)
NIDHI-EIR support discontinues if recipient raises external funding
Government of Gujarat grants require startup to be registered as LLP or private limited company in Gujarat
iCreate Idea Catalyst (iIC) batch timings are fixed (e.g., Batch 4 in July 2026)
Spark-up Idea Fund is only for students
NIDHI-SSS is for slightly mature startups (1-3 years old) with revenue preference
Some programs require physical incubation at iCreate Campus
Past batches do not guarantee future availability; check latest announcements
